The forgiveness of sins
The resurrection of the body
Life everlasting

questions.explanation: The Catechism teaches that 'the communion of saints is the Church' itself -- the phrase describes the spiritual bond uniting all the faithful, living and dead, in Christ.

questions.prompt: Why does the Church honor the memory of the saints, according to the Catechism?

citations.quote: It is not merely by the title of example that we cherish the memory of those in heaven; we seek, rather, that by this devotion... the union of the whole Church in the Spirit may be strengthened.

A title given to someone only after their own death has occurred, never before it

questions.hint: Ask what exactly is being honored when a saint is honored — the person alone, or what God did in them.
